title: Average bottle brush
text: Average bottle brush. Nothing particularly special - the brush works well for glasses, mugs and water bottles. I had a different brush before this one that had slightly stiffer bristles and was more versatile for use on other dishes and cookware in addition to the typical bottle brush targets.

product_metadata.title: OXO SteeL Bottle Brush,Black,10 In
features: Long, durable neck flexes for easy reach inside bottles, pitchers and carafes
Stiff blue bristles give hard-to-reach corners a serious scrub, while white bristles are ---gentle enough to clean wine glasses and crystal without scratching
Soft, non-slip handle provides a comfortable grip, even when wet
Easily stored in a kitchen caddy or hung from a hook
Also great for stemware, baby bottles and other delicate containers
description: With a dual-function bristle head designed for gentle cleaning and serious scrubbing, and a long neck flexes with ease, reaching those tough-to-get areas inside bottles, pitchers and carafes. The OXO SteeL Bottle Brush is more than your average kitchen scrubber. The handle provides a soft non-slip grip, even when wet. Dishwasher safe, store it in your sink caddy or hang it from a hook. Safe for pots and pans, stemware, baby bottles and other delicate containers.
